title: Only one Categories column shows a sort arrow at a time
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • {Location-A} is connected to QuickBooks, so the Categories list shows the QuickBooks Products And Services column.
  • QuickBooks product or service {Qb-item-A} (for example the item that comes first in the QuickBooks list) exists.
  • QuickBooks product or service {Qb-item-B} (for example the item that comes last in the QuickBooks list) exists.
  • Category {Category-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC29 alpha) is mapped to {Qb-item-B}.
  • Category {Category-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC29 Beta) is mapped to {Qb-item-A}.
  • You are on a page other than Categories, so the list opens sorted by Name.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Categories in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Click the QuickBooks Products And Services column header.
  3. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  4. Look at the Name header and the QuickBooks header.
  5. Read the order of {Category-A} and {Category-B}.
  6. Click the Name column header.
  7. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  8. Look at the Name header and the QuickBooks header.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: only the QuickBooks header shows an arrow (pointing up). The Name header shows no arrow.
  • Step 5: {Category-B} is above {Category-A}, so the list is ordered by the QuickBooks value alone and not by name.
  • Step 8: only the Name header shows an arrow. The QuickBooks header shows no arrow.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10134 (Story 1, Categories, sort by name; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S1-R13, S1-R14, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.2 (Categories - after), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct.
